hero.subtitle: Fantasy cycling with friends. Live auctions, real UCI races, pure strategy.

auction.title: Draft at auctions
auction.text: Browse the peloton, filter by price or UCI category, and bid on the riders you want.

bid.title: Place your bids
bid.desc: Pick a rider and bid what you want. But watch out — your budget is limited!

win.title: Highest bidder wins
win.desc: When the round closes, the highest bid wins the rider for their team.

rounds.title: Multiple rounds
rounds.desc: Auctions run over several successive rounds. Adapt your strategy each time.

team.title: Build your full squad
team.desc: Round after round, assemble a complete team of riders ready to score.

team.title: Build your team
team.text: Climbers, sprinters, rouleurs — track your squad's points as the races unfold.

stages.title: Points on every stage
stages.desc: Your riders score points on each stage based on their finish position.

jerseys.title: Classification bonuses
jerseys.desc: GC, points, mountains, youth — each jersey earns bonus points.

optimize.title: Optimize your roster
optimize.desc: Analyze performance and adjust your squad phase after phase.

realtime.title: Real-time tracking
realtime.desc: Follow every rider's points across races and weeks.

ranking.title: Follow the pro calendar
ranking.text: From .1 races to Monuments, every race counts for your ranking.

allRaces.title: All UCI races
allRaces.desc: WorldTour, ProSeries, .1 races — every race on the pro calendar is included.

startlists.title: Full startlists
startlists.desc: Check the start list for every race to anticipate points.

strategy.title: Plan your strategy
strategy.desc: Anticipate results and optimize your picks race by race.

calendar.title: Visual calendar
calendar.desc: Monthly view with upcoming races, color-coded categories and startlist validations.

classement.title: Dominate the rankings
classement.text: General, weekly, by rider or chrono — multiple ways to shine.

general.title: General ranking
general.desc: Accumulate points from all your riders across the season and prove you're the best.

weekly.title: Weekly ranking
weekly.desc: Every week, a new showdown. Even if you're behind overall, you can shine over 7 days.

trash.title: Trash talk your friends
trash.desc: Compare yourself to your mates in real-time and remind them you know cycling better.

climb.title: Climb to the top
climb.desc: Track your progress week by week and aim for the top spot in your league.

auction.title: Show them who's
auction.subtitle: Place 3 riders on the podium in every race. Strategy, bluff and adrenaline — the auction between friends is the heart of the game.

quote1.text: There's always some crazy guy who puts 1000M on Pogačar. Personally, I focus on Asian races.
quote1.author: Bubu

quote2.text: For me, it's Landa, Pedersen, and Schmidt – I've got my guys. No one dares touch them. And I've had quite a bit of success too.
quote2.author: Matt B

cta.title: Ready to start
cta.subtitle: Invite your friends and start playing today.
